replicaCount.description: Number of controller replicas to deploy.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the controller manager pod.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified release name.

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created.

automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

name.description: The name of the service account to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

create.description: Specifies whether RBAC resources should be created.

createAdminRoles.description: Specifies whether cluster-admin helper roles for VISA CRDs should be created.

operatorScopeNamespace.description: Limits the operator watch to specific namespace(s) (comma-separated). If empty, the controller watches all namespaces across the cluster.

managedImagePullSecrets.description: Comma-separated list of image pull secret names to pass to VISA instances managed by the controller.

enabled.description: Leader election ensures only one active controller manager runs at a time in HA setups.

bindAddress.description: Bind address for health probe endpoints.

port.description: Port number for health probe endpoints.

bindAddress.description: Bind address for the metrics endpoint. Set to '0' to disable.

port.description: Port number for the metrics endpoint.

secure.description: If true, the metrics endpoint is served securely via HTTPS with authn/authz filter.

certPath.description: Path to certificates for securing metrics (optional).

certName.description: Certificate file name for metrics TLS.

certKey.description: Certificate key file name for metrics TLS.

certPath.description: Path to certificates for webhook server (optional).

certName.description: Certificate file name for webhook TLS.

certKey.description: Certificate key file name for webhook TLS.

enableHttp2.description: Enable HTTP/2 for metrics and webhook servers (disabled by default due to CVE vulnerabilities).

extraArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to the controller binary.

env.description: Additional environment variables to pass to the controller container.

targetPort.description: Target port for the metrics service.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the controller container.

enabled.description: Specifies whether a PodDisruptionBudget should be created.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number/percentage of pods that must still be available after eviction.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number/percentage of pods that can be unavailable after eviction.

volumes.description: Additional volumes to attach to the pod.

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the controller container.
